name: Thailand Payments
description: PromptPay QR plus non-custodial manual-link fallback for local/self-hosted Wabi instances.
author: Wabi Core

security.threatNotes: Non-custodial only. Plugin never stores card or bank secrets in frontend payloads. Manual link route is demo/test and must stay behind trusted operator environments.

capabilities.notes: Provider plugin for PromptPay QR flows and local simulation fallback.

methods.label: PromptPay QR
methods.notes: Generates EMVCo payload for PromptPay QR scanning.

methods.label: Manual Link (Demo)
methods.notes: Local non-custodial fallback for development and smoke tests.
